scope: Complete current discovered CSS motion rules/keyframes and explicit imperative APIs, with per-family duration rationale and reduced cascade applicability. Direct24-context component outcomes are distinguished from source-backed selector aliases. Final whole39 acceptance requires independent and root review.

instant-reduction.normal: Not a normal-motion treatment; these are explicit reduced-motion cascade safeguards.
instant-reduction.reduced: Global authored !important reset wins over every normal animation/transition declaration, including generated pseudo-elements. Browser visible-state scans across24 contexts confirm none on rendered targets.
instant-reduction.duration: none /0s; earlier0.01ms compatibility rule is superseded by the later animation:none/transition:none reset.

shared-fast.normal: 120ms ease feedback changes paint, focus borders, shadows, short hover translation, or small switch/chevron movement; source aliases use the same token.
shared-fast.reduced: Instant state changes via the global important reset; event handlers, labels, focus, selection and field values stay unchanged. Native auth/account/menu/profile/Rules/Limits/import outcomes are checked.
shared-fast.duration: 120ms shared token; no perpetual motion or delayed mutation.

compat-fast.normal: 150ms legacy compatibility feedback for chip/filter/page-control paint; no scheduling or data operations depend on the CSS timing.
compat-fast.reduced: Same global important reset as the120ms controls; source-backed aliases need no duplicate native application controls to establish that cascade.
compat-fast.duration: 150ms finite paint transitions, close to the120ms fast role; deliberate compatibility literals retained.

sidebar.normal: 200ms shared base transform lets the menu enter/leave with its existing focus and inert handling.
sidebar.reduced: Instant menu transform. Actual320px native open/close and return-to-toggle focus checked in all three engines.

bar-height.normal: 300ms shared slow token interpolates a chart bar height when its data presentation changes. This is a visual alias, not a delayed data update or inferred percentage.
bar-height.reduced: Chart height changes immediately under the global important transition reset; source-backed applicability, not a claim this data-dependent chart was rendered in the24 contexts.
bar-height.duration: 300ms finite height transition; restrained slow role.

unit-emphasis.normal: 2400ms one-shot color emphasis identifies the exact posting revealed by a validation link. This is longer than a UI transition to provide a brief location cue, not a long geometry animation or continuous pulse.
unit-emphasis.reduced: No animation, while persistent highlight border/shadow and the actual exact posting reveal remain. Native unit warning outcomes checked in both preferences, all engines and widths.
unit-emphasis.duration: 2400ms single iteration; justified destination emphasis exception.

backdrop.normal: 150ms one-shot backdrop fade on actual account/unit modal opening.
backdrop.reduced: Backdrop appears immediately; modal semantics, close and return focus remain. Actual modal and pending account states checked.

dialog-scale.reduced: No scale animation; actual account/unit dialog contents, fields and close controls remain usable.

toast-entry.normal: 200ms one-shot slide-in; error message persists with a native Dismiss action. Notification timing and focus behavior do not rely on animation completion.
toast-entry.reduced: No slide-in; actual status/error text and native Dismiss remain functional.
toast-entry.duration: 200ms one-shot entry; premium rule supersedes the earlier fadeOut tuple.

legacy-toast-overridden.normal: Earlier toast rule defines slideInRight plus fadeOut, but the later production premium-theme .toast animation replaces the entire shorthand with slideInRight only. No other source rule references fadeOut.
legacy-toast-overridden.reduced: Both declarations yield to the global important reset.
legacy-toast-overridden.duration: Legacy300ms fadeOut after4.5s is dormant under the production load order, not an active exit treatment or a tested exit animation.

generic-pending.normal: 750ms linear rotation repeats only while the actual auth/account action is pending and disables its submit control. It signals indeterminate work, never invented progress.
generic-pending.reduced: Stationary spinner plus visible Loading text and existing disabled/busy state;503 releases the pending control and retains real entered values.
generic-pending.duration: 750ms continuous pending loop; lifecycle-bound loading exception, not a finite UI transition.

skeleton-pending.normal: 1200ms shimmer repeats while a real read is held, with explicit Loading text and aria-busy.
skeleton-pending.reduced: Static skeleton fields plus identical Loading/busy state; releasing real Limits/member reads reaches ready or explicit retry/recovery.
skeleton-pending.duration: 1200ms pending shimmer loop; continuous only while loading, no percentage meaning.

balance-pending.normal: 900ms linear spinner repeats only while actual balance status/preview reads are held; text explains work.
balance-pending.reduced: Static spinner plus visible Working out a fair share status; refused preview offers manual retry and known-balanced result removes the spinner. No Apply occurs.

disclosure-chevron.normal: 150ms rotation signals native disclosure expansion. Actual Balance about disclosure opens/closes and preserves Already balanced completion text.
disclosure-chevron.reduced: Instant chevron state; native details open state and text remain. Grouped aliases share the same rule.

root-scroll.normal: Root smooth-scroll preference influences default scroll calls; explicit instant positioning is kept instant. Five guarded native calls additionally choose smooth/auto themselves.
root-scroll.reduced: Global scroll-behavior:auto!important applies to all elements/pseudos. Native five guarded sites prove exact destinations and focus outcomes.
root-scroll.duration: Browser-managed smooth scrolling; no custom timing or data operation depends on completion.

tokens.normal: Explicit120/200/300ms fast/base/slow role definitions, asserted unchanged in all12 pathway contexts.
tokens.reduced: Consumers are overridden to immediate transitions/none animation.
